headline: Liberia Supreme Court Issues 21-Day Ultimatum to Bea Mountain Mining
summary: The Supreme Court of Liberia has given the Bea Mountain Mining Company a 21-day ultimatum to conduct a survey involving encroachment claims by citizens.
why: Mining concessions face legal and community compliance risks that can affect operational continuity and asset valuation.

impacts.name: Bea Mountain Mining Company
impacts.why: Judicial directives require operational compliance and surveys within a strict timeframe.
